verdict.rationale: dlt is an open-source Python library: pipelines are written as Python code (or declarative REST API config) and run anywhere Python runs, including laptops, Airflow, Lambda, containers and GitHub Actions. Destinations can be swapped without changing pipeline code. Community users independently praise doing everything via code and dropping it into an existing project. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of repo-resident config files and a documented version-control or code-review workflow.
